data.title: High Gardens
data.about:
High Gardens at Damac Hills have the most exquisitely crafted terrace apartments with 1, 2, 3 bedrooms to choose from. At High Gardens, you can enjoy the garden and open space of a villa while living amidst the urban vibe of an apartment. Doused in greenery in its surroundings, these homes offer you an exciting lifestyle. With access to the Trump International Golf Club, High Gardens is the perfect pick if you wanna live in the midst of nature in one of Dubai’s most sought-after family communities.

High Gardens is nestled ideally in Damac Hills, which offers its residents amenities like no other. You can access shops like Carrefour and Spinneys, as well as KHDA rated “very good” Jebel Ali Secondary school, a huge community skate park, multiple play areas for the kids, as well as tennis courts, cricket pitch, & football field. Equestrian enthusiasts will have access to stables with horse riding lessons for adults and kids. It is located just minutes from the Mall of Emirates, the beach, Madinat Jumeirah, Business Bay and Dubai Marina. This is a dream place to find your next home!
